node.title: XR prize primitive first shell is empty
node.statement: On the first residual shell |X|=a+3, trade rank is at most three. A rank-three row space is the complete three-dimensional dual GRS_a code; its in-union zero sets are distinct graph edges, with at most one singleton disjoint from every edge, and its polynomial rows satisfy exact unweighted and slope-weighted checks. The graph-incidence Maxwell deficit is positive at every prize row because the core has at most 384,448,960 blocks while h is at least 2^32+1. Rank one is impossible and prize full-core rank two is already excluded. Hence no trade of any rank can be active on every block of a prize Maxwell core on this shell. Proper local circuits remain open.
